name: Komorebi.QuantumArithmetic.arithmetic_signal_quantum_bridge

    matVec projector12 testSignal12 = ramanujan12 ∧
    (List.range 12).map (dft12 ramanujanCVector) =
      [cRat 0, cRat 12, cRat 0, cRat 0, cRat 0, cRat 12,
       cRat 0, cRat 12, cRat 0, cRat 0, cRat 0, cRat 12] ∧
    sqEntries ramanujan12 = sqEntries absRamanujan12

name: Komorebi.QuantumArithmetic.complete_phase_separation
statement_source:
theorem complete_phase_separation :
    totalProbability psi = 1 ∧ totalProbability chi = 1 ∧
    (∀ i, Complex.normSq (psi i) = Complex.normSq (chi i)) ∧
    (∑ i, star (psi i) * chi i) = 0 ∧
    coprimeProbability (Fᴴ.mulVec psi) = 1 ∧
    coprimeProbability (Fᴴ.mulVec chi) = 0

name: Komorebi.QuantumArithmetic.publication_bridge
statement_source:
theorem publication_bridge :
    Fᴴ * F = 1 ∧ F * Fᴴ = 1 ∧ F * D * Fᴴ = P ∧
    P * P = P ∧ Pᴴ = P ∧ F.mulVec unitState = psi ∧
    Fᴴ.mulVec psi = unitState ∧ totalProbability psi = 1 ∧
    totalProbability chi = 1 ∧
    (∀ i, Complex.normSq (psi i) = Complex.normSq (chi i)) ∧
    (∑ i, star (psi i) * chi i) = 0 ∧
    coprimeProbability (Fᴴ.mulVec psi) = 1 ∧
    coprimeProbability (Fᴴ.mulVec chi) = 0
